lots.guide_summary: Four Gowans SOLD lots of the same cased Bond models, Sept 2026: $55 (10), $55 (12), $90 (14), $90 (13) hammer, all opened and photos checked. Per model $4.60 to $6.90 hammer, so 19 to 20 models suggests roughly $90 to $130 hammer. Two eBay single-model asking leads ($26 to $38, snippet only) are not prices paid. No unsold. GBP at assumed 2.0.
lots.working: Keep: lowest same-item SOLD rate is $55 / 12 = $4.58 per model. 19 Eaglemoss models x $4.58 = $87 (Lincoln counted at nil). $87 / 1.22 = $71.3, round down $70 (all-in $85.40). Flip: likely resale 19 x $5.50 = $105 hammer in a Tasmanian room, less 15% vendor commission (assumed) = $89, local so no postage; $89 / 2.44 = $36.6, round down $35. Note the 13 and 14 model lots both made $90, so bigger lots do not scale fully.
